headline: Alarm in the Country: Massacres Israel
summary: Tel Aviv University data show about 270,000 Israelis emigrated in 2023-2025. Experts warn the record wave, led by doctors and engineers, could become a permanent brain drain.
why: Emigration of skilled professionals reduces an economy's human capital and tax base, which can weigh on long-term growth and productivity.
